title: T-SQL Quick Reference
description: Look up a lesson idea, see its small example, and check a common mistake. Open the linked lesson for setup and practice steps.

entries.name: Ask for a message
entries.summary: SELECT asks for a result. AS gives its column a name.

entries.name: Name a local number
entries.summary: DECLARE makes a local variable. T-SQL variable names start with @.
notes: The variable exists only in its batch or procedure scope.

entries.name: Join text values
entries.summary: CONCAT joins values as text. It can also convert simple number inputs to text.
notes: Do not assume + behaves the same way with NULL and mixed types.

entries.name: Choose a result
entries.summary: CASE returns a value from the first matching branch.

example.code:
DECLARE @score int = 8;
SELECT CASE WHEN @score >= 5 THEN 'Pass' ELSE 'Try again' END AS message;

notes: CASE ends with END; it is an expression, not an IF block.

entries.name: Choose which statement runs
entries.summary: IF controls which SQL statements run. BEGIN and END group statements.
notes: Use BEGIN and END when a branch has several statements.

entries.name: Make a small result table
entries.summary: VALUES can create rows for a query. An alias names the tiny table and its column.

example.code: SELECT n FROM (VALUES (3), (1), (2)) AS numbers(n) ORDER BY n;

notes: Use ORDER BY when the row order matters.

entries.name: Keep matching rows
entries.summary: WHERE keeps rows that pass a condition.

example.code: SELECT n FROM (VALUES (4), (8), (9)) AS scores(n) WHERE n >= 7 ORDER BY n;

notes: WHERE filters rows before they are grouped.

entries.name: Add values across rows
entries.summary: SUM adds a column over the selected rows.

example.code: SELECT SUM(n) AS total FROM (VALUES (2), (3), (4)) AS numbers(n);

notes: SUM ignores NULL inputs; it does not treat them as a known zero.

entries.name: Choose a missing-value fallback
entries.summary: COALESCE returns the first input that is not NULL.

example.code:
DECLARE @name varchar(20) = NULL;
SELECT COALESCE(@name, 'Guest') AS name;

notes: Use IS NULL for a null test, not = NULL.

entries.name: Read a number safely
entries.summary: TRY_CONVERT returns NULL when this text cannot be converted to int. COALESCE then supplies zero.
notes: A failed conversion is not automatically a real score of zero; choose a suitable fallback for your app.

entries.name: Repeat with WHILE
entries.summary: WHILE repeats its block while a rule stays true.
notes: Change the loop value so the loop eventually stops.

entries.name: Read a JSON field
entries.summary: JSON_VALUE reads one simple value from JSON text using a path.
notes: Use valid JSON with double-quoted field names.
